question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Aquire"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Acquire".

 
 
• **Example: **He managed to acquire a rare book for his collection.
 
 
 
• **"Acquire"** means to come into possession or control of something, often by one's own efforts. (प्राप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **In order to succeed, one must acquire new skills and knowledge.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Congratulate **(बधाई देना): To praise someone for an achievement.

 
 
• **Example:** We went to congratulate her on her promotion.
 
 
 
• **Category **(श्रेणी): A class or division of people or things regarded as having particular shared characteristics.
 
 
• **Example: **The books are organized by category in the library.
 
 
 
• **Hygiene** (स्वच्छता): Conditions or practices conducive to maintaining health and preventing disease, especially through cleanliness.
 
 
• **Example:** Good personal hygiene is essential to prevent the spread of illnesses.
